Definition: from G2095 and a derivative of G5177; well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man:--Eutychus.
BiblicalUsage: Eutychus is a young man from Troas whose name means well-fated, fortunate. In Acts 20:9, the text says "And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus." The life behind the name is told on the Eutychus People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eútychos matters because God knows His people by name, and Eútychos is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
